title: RegionFM: Interpretable Region-Based Brain MRI Classification Using Foundation Model Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2607.16325v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Foundation models provide powerful representations for brain MRI analysis, but their predictions remain difficult to interpret in anatomically meaningful terms. Clinical assessment of brain MRI is commonly organized around anatomically defined structures and regional abnormalities, whereas conventional explanation methods typically produce voxel- or patch-level importance maps that do not explicitly quantify the contributions of individual brain regions. To address this mismatch, we propose RegionFM, an interpretable framework that integrates anatomical segmentation with brain MRI foundation-model embeddings. translated_title: RegionFM：基于基础模型嵌入的可解释区域化脑部MRI分类
translated_abstract: 基础模型为脑部MRI分析提供了强大的表示能力，但其预测结果仍难以用具有解剖学意义的方式进行解释。脑部MRI的临床评估通常围绕解剖学定义的结构和区域性异常来组织，而传统的解释方法通常生成体素级或图像块级的重要性图，无法显式量化各个脑区各自的贡献。为解决这一不匹配问题，我们提出了RegionFM，一个将解剖学分割与脑部MRI基础模型嵌入相集成的可解释框架。RegionFM首先将每个MRI扫描划分为解剖学区域，并为每个区域构建单独的MRI体积。随后，一个冻结的基础模型将每个区域编码为嵌入向量，区域加性逻辑回归模型将这些嵌入组合起来，使得每个解剖学区域都对预测结果贡献一个显式的标量项。
tldr: RegionFM提出了一种可解释的脑部MRI分类框架，通过将解剖学分割与基础模型嵌入相结合，使每个脑区对分类预测的贡献能够被显式量化。
en_tdlr: RegionFM is an interpretable brain MRI classification framework that integrates anatomical segmentation with foundation model embeddings, enabling explicit quantification of each brain region's contribution to the prediction.
